mechanism_narrative: The sustained week-over-week decline in retail and recreation mobility over the past four weeks establishes a strong negative trend that will persist, leading to further decreases in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week increase in WORKPLACES mobility, as observed from t-2w to t-0w, signals a gradual return to office-based work, which will incrementally boost adjacent retail and recreation activity over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days despite WORKPLACES rising by more than 10 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of persistently high residential mobility and extremely low transit station activity indicates a strong preference for staying home and avoiding public transport, which will continue to suppress retail and recreation visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above 10% and TRANSIT remains below -60%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in grocery and pharmacy mobility, as seen over the last four weeks, implies either stricter public health measures or heightened public caution, which will further reduce non-essential retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM continuing its downward trend.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp decline in parks mobility from t-2w to t-1w, following a temporary increase, indicates reduced outdoor activity, likely due to changing weather or renewed caution, which will negatively impact general out-of-home retail and recreation over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 20 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 7 days after a week-on-week drop in PARKS exceeding 20 points.

mechanism_narrative: Even with a recent modest increase in workplace mobility, the persistently high residential mobility indicates that a significant portion of the population continues to work from home or limit non-essential outings, thereby suppressing retail and recreation activity over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days while WORKPLACES remains below -30% and RESIDENTIAL remains above 10%.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained and extremely low levels of transit station mobility, showing no significant recovery, reflect a deep reluctance or inability to travel across the metropolitan area, which will continue to depress retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT remaining below -60%.

mechanism_narrative: If the recent rebound in workplace mobility is accompanied by a subsequent increase in transit station activity, it would signal a broader easing of mobility restrictions and a return to pre-pandemic commuting patterns, leading to a positive uplift in retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by more than 10 points week-on-week AND TRANSIT rises by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days even if WORKPLACES rises by more than 10 points and TRANSIT rises by more than 2 points week-on-week.
